repos_data.description: 🚀 A self-hostable personal dashboard built for you. Includes status-checking, widgets, themes, icon packs, a UI editor and tons more!

repo_meta_data.description: DVinyl is a self-hostable collection management platform for collectors. Catalog, organize and track physical media and collectibles with custom item types, rich metadata, multi-collection support, authentication, and powerful import tools.
